extension.name: Facility Calendar Upcoming Event List — Modern Soft Blue

notes.note: Critical install fix: removed empty <files> and <languages> blocks from the flat package manifest. Joomla 3's PackageAdapter::copyBaseFiles() passes a null value to count() when those blocks are absent or empty, causing a fatal error on PHP 8.2+ during install. All file deployment is now handled exclusively by script.php postflight; the package manifest contains only the scriptfile and updateservers.

Critical uninstall fix: converted from package+file-extension to a flat single-package architecture. The separate file extension (modernsoftblue.xml) was a child extension whose uninstall ran before the package uninstall, deleting deployed files and corrupting Joomla's manifest lookup, which caused 'Package Uninstall: Missing manifest file' on every uninstall attempt. The package now deploys all files manually via postflight and cleans them up in its own uninstall script. Only one extension entry in #__extensions; uninstall always succeeds.

Critical package uninstall fix: changed the file extension's packagename from `facilitycalendar-upcomingeventlist-modernsoftblue` to `facilitycalendar-upcomingeventlist-modernsoftblue-files`. Both the package and file extension previously shared the same packagename, causing Joomla's `#__extensions` table entry for the package to be overwritten by the file extension during install. When uninstalling the package, Joomla then looked up the file extension's manifest path instead of the package manifest, resulting in "Missing manifest file" and preventing package removal. The file extension now has a unique packagename and uninstalls cleanly.

Bug fix: removed scc-calendar-badge.png from the file manifest fileset and removed the checkBadge() installer hook. The badge file was never committed to the repository, causing Joomla to warn 'File does not exist' during install. The floating badge is now absent from the card; all other features are unaffected.

Critical uninstall fix: revertModuleManifestPatch() now always returns true during uninstall, making backup restore a best-effort cleanup rather than a hard blocker. Previously, if the manifest backup was missing or the lock could not be acquired, the uninstall script returned false, which caused Joomla to report the package as broken and prevented removal. The uninstall path now reports a warning and always allows package removal to proceed. This fixes the "Missing manifest file" uninstall failure on production hosts where backups were lost or tmp was unwritable.

Adversarial security review fixes: fixed critical uninstall data-loss bug where backup was deleted before restore success check, leaving upstream module manifest corrupt on failure; replaced unbounded ob_start() with adaptive memory guard computed from host memory_limit (256KB–2MB clamp); hardened XXE regex to match multi-line DOCTYPEs; added backup file size verification after write and copy destination size verification after restore; replaced lock file TOCTOU race with atomic O_CREAT-style creation; added tmp_path validation with fallback to JPATH_ROOT/tmp; scoped time normalization regex to actual time values to prevent silent mutation of non-time content; added post-transform DOM output validation with 20% length-change threshold to detect silent structural changes; moved update server URL to immutable updates branch; added checksum verification instructions to README; namespaced wrapper ID to prevent global namespace pollution; normalized path separators for Windows compatibility.

Production hardening: replaced fragile regex HTML parsing in modernsoftblue.php with DOMDocument-based parsing targeting .facility-event-time elements by class, eliminating silent breakage on upstream HTML changes; added 512KB output buffer size limit with graceful degradation to raw HTML on large event lists, preventing memory exhaustion on cheap shared hosting; bumped all version surfaces to 1.5.5.

Production hardening: removed InstallerAdapter type hints from all installer methods to restore Joomla 3.8.x compatibility (InstallerAdapter was introduced in Joomla 3.9 and caused fatal errors on 3.8.x); replaced remaining @unlink() error-suppression operators with file_exists() guards in script.php; wrapped libxml_disable_entity_loader(true) in PHP version guard for PHP 8.0+ forward compatibility; added XML well-formedness validation after DOM save and before disk write to prevent corrupt manifests; moved lock file from web-accessible modules directory to JPATH_ROOT/tmp/; added LOCK_EX to backup copy operation to prevent partial reads; added backup integrity check in revertModuleManifestPatch(); fixed clearstatcache() ordering in modernsoftblue.php to avoid warnings when CSS file does not exist; bumped all version surfaces to 1.5.4.

Bug fixes: added missing clock.svg file and declared it in the file manifest fileset so the CSS clock icon deploys correctly on install; replaced @filemtime() error-suppression operator with explicit file_exists() check in modernsoftblue.php; replaced @unlink() error-suppression operators with file_exists() guards in script.php; removed trailing garbage line from README.md; updated all version surfaces to 1.5.3.

Bug fix: removed non-standard <tags> GPG signing placeholder from update.xml that broke Joomla 3 JUpdater during update checks; CSS cache-buster now uses filemtime() + clearstatcache(true, ...) instead of hardcoded version; CSS clock icon reference externalized from inline SVG data URI to clock.svg for maintainability; filter: drop-shadow() replaced with box-shadow for Joomla 3 CSS compatibility; BADGE_MISSING language string path corrected from /images/ to media folder; package/file manifests bumped to 1.5.2; update server URL changed to raw.githubusercontent.com to bypass GitHub Pages CDN cache.

Production-quality CSS and template polish. Switched the layout override to load the stylesheet via Joomla's HTMLHelper::stylesheet() API (relative path, cache-busting mtime query string, detectDebug disabled since no .min variant is shipped) instead of building an absolute URL with Uri::root() — this works correctly on reverse-proxy / CDN-fronted hosts where Uri::root() can disagree with the asset base URL. Added a font-smoothing / text-rendering block on the card wrapper, a focus-within state on the date tile (mirrors the hover state for keyboard users), a prefers-reduced-motion media query to disable the tile lift, word-break on long event titles, and a :focus state on event links. Added responsive @media rules for tablet (max-width: 768px) and phone (max-width: 480px). The local $app usage in the template is now scoped via Factory::getApplication() rather than relying on a leaked global. The update.xml <changelogurl> now points at the GitHub Pages feed (https://jaydenrussell.github.io/facilitycalendar-modernsoftblue/CHANGELOG.xml) instead of raw.githubusercontent.com for consistency with the <updateservers> URL and to avoid the raw URL's Jekyll-style 404 page in the Joomla updater view.

Code quality fixes: replaced all hardcoded inline English error strings in script.php with corresponding language keys so they can be localised. Added five new keys: XML_NOT_WRITABLE, BACKUP_FAILED, WRITE_FAILED, RESTORE_FAILED, and RESTORE_MANIFEST. Fixed CHANGELOG.xml: the v1.4.1 note contained unescaped > characters which, while tolerated by PHP/libxml, violate the XML spec and can cause failures in strict XML parsers and validators. Removed orphaned mod_ language INI files (mod_..._modernsoftblue.ini and .sys.ini were never functional for a file extension display name) and their references from the file manifest, since the package name is now a literal string. Removed orphaned pkg_ name/description/layout_label keys from the language INI file; kept all keys still referenced by the installer script.

Fixed extension display names showing raw language keys (PKG_FACILITYCALENDAR_UPCOMINGEVENTLIST_MODERNSOFTBLUE and MOD_FACILITYCALENDAR_UPCOMINGEVENTLIST_MODERNSOFTBLUE) in the Joomla admin Extensions list. Joomla 3 resolves a package name via .sys.ini and a file extension's name via a files_<element>.sys file; the file manifest's MOD_... key is not resolvable for a file extension, so the raw key was shown. Replaced the package and file manifest <name>/<description> with literal friendly strings (JText::_ returns literals unchanged), matching the update.xml name, so the real name always displays regardless of language-file loading. Installer-localized (PKG_...) error messages are unaffected.

Fixed the Joomla 3.10 install abort. The v1.4.0 (and earlier) package failed to install because the file manifest declared <languages folder="language"> while the files actually live under files/language/, so the language files could not be found and the installer aborted mid-install. The package manifest also listed CHANGELOG.xml as a child extension and referenced inert <install>/<update>/<media> blocks that the Joomla 3 file adapter ignores, so modernsoftblue.css was never deployed. This release points both <languages> declarations at the real folders, removes CHANGELOG.xml from the package files list, ships modernsoftblue.css via the Joomla-3 fileset to media/mod_facilitycalendar_upcomingeventlist_modernsoftblue/, and drops the inert blocks. Also repointed the package's own pkg language folder so the installer script's messages localize.

Update-server hardening and installer cleanup: added a SHA-256 checksum to update.xml so the Joomla Update component (and Joomla 4, where a mismatch is a hard failure) can verify the downloaded package integrity. Replaced leftover inline installer error strings with the existing language keys so all user-facing messages are localizable. Reworded the badge-missing message to match the new behaviour (the badge is now shipped by the package). Removed the extraneous patch/mod_facilitycalendar_event_list.xml, which was a throwaway target manifest not referenced by the installer and inconsistent with the shipped layout.

Fixed Joomla 3 deployability and consistency: added a Joomla-3 fileset to the file manifest so the template override (templates/tpl_jdseattle/html/mod_facilitycalendar_event_list/) and the scc-calendar-badge.png image actually deploy on install (previously neither was declared). Fixed the badge CSS path to resolve to the site /images/ directory from the media folder. Bumped the declared minimum PHP from 7.2 to 7.4 to match the typed-property code, in README and preflight.

Fixed Joomla 3.10 compatibility: removed the Joomla 4-only InstallerScriptInterface (which does not exist in Joomla 3.10 and caused a fatal "interface not found" at install); the installer script is now a duck-typed Joomla 3 InstallerScript. Bumped all version surfaces (package manifest, file manifest, update.xml, changelog) to 1.2.0 and corrected the update.xml download URL to the real release asset.

Production hardening: fixed installer postflight method (was using non-existent postinstall), replaced regex XML patching with DOMDocument, added LOCK_EX file locking, added is_writable() checks, added preflight compatibility checks, added uninstall rollback, externalized CSS to media file, fixed update server URL, fixed hardcoded image path, added language files, added index.html files, added blockChildUninstall, added changelogurl, bumped to Joomla 3.8+ installer interface.
Initial release. Card-style theme for mod_facilitycalendar_event_list with light rounded date tiles, hairline dividers, semibold titles, and muted times.
